technique_cue_conflicts_resolved.note: No conflicts. Only four crops carry cue classes: F3d, F3e (micrograph) cited with technique SEM, and F5b, F5c (micrograph) cited with technique [SEM, TEM] on o7/a1 - both families are listed under the 'micrograph' cue in trace_kit/cue_technique.json. Every other cited crop has cue classes [] and is therefore not checked: F3a/F4a/F4b/F5a/F6a/F6d/F7a (schematics, no technique attr), F3b/F3c/F4f/F4g/F4h/F5d (plots), F5e (EDS maps), F6b/F6c/F6e/F6f (ex vivo fluorescence), F7b/F7c (tables), F7d/F7e (H&E).
F5e carries no cue class although it is an EDS map set; technique EDS:mapping is taken from the caption ('EDS mapping') and the C/Zn/N/P labels printed on the maps, not from a cue.
No citation was dropped or re-pointed for a technique/cue disagreement.

merged_nodes: The 5 um and 1 um SEM views of F3D were read as one node (o3) together with F3E, since the claim is the microfluidic-vs-hydrothermal comparison, not two separate magnifications.

A separate 'crystal habit' STR node for the neat ZIF-8 was dropped: the habit reading and the caption's 'cubic' wording sit in attrs.image_note of o3, and the habit claim survives only for the loaded and coated MOFs (n10), where it carries an argument.
The three encapsulation panels F4F, F4G and F4H state one claim (microfluidic > hydrothermal for every cargo) and were written as one OBS node o5 rather than one per cargo.
The three cargo SEM panels F4C, F4D and F4E were written as one OBS node o6 for the same reason.
PRC/stimulus nodes for the in-vivo dosing were not created: the administration route, dose and time point are carried by attrs.condition on n17, n18 and n20 (r04 ruling 36).

The lymph-node and tumour targeting claims were kept as two nodes (n17, n18) - different aptamer, model and readout - and form the two allowed parallel branches; the biosafety claim n20 and the zeta-potential claim n15 were moved off the spine so the two-branch discipline holds.
notes: F1 (table-of-contents graphic) and F2 (journal cover thumbnail) were opened but carry no caption, no OCR and no citable content; they are front matter, not paper figures. Node total is 43, just above the protocol's 25-40 aim, because the paper runs two independent in-vivo branches with image plus bar-chart evidence each.
